title: Campaign bundle manifest
description: manifest.json at the root of a campaign bundle produced by `gtme freeze --bundle` (SPEC.md §8, ADR-029). A bundle is self-contained (run resolves nothing outside it except credentials), diffable (text files, stable ordering), and portable (contracts travel; membership and cache stay with the ledger). DRAFT: authored in the ADR-022..029 reconciliation pass ahead of the build; the freeze/run/simulate acceptance criteria will harden it.

bundle_format_version.description: Format version of the bundle layout itself.

source_run_id.description: The run whose stored config snapshot this bundle was reconstructed from.

gtm_version.description: Version of the gtme binary that produced the bundle (informational).

contents.description: Every file in the bundle except this manifest, keyed by bundle-relative path, valued by its sha256 hex digest. Stable (sorted-path) ordering when serialized.
